column2: [intro]
In the street, I stumbled upon a sock with a hole
It danced on the sidewalk, it had a carefree soul
I found it so funny, I started to laugh
A sock without a pair can still make a path
Ugly but cool things, they really exist
Something ordinary can become a twist
A pimple on a nose can be quite chic
Oddities, they make us unique
A cat with a hat, it’s really got style
It strolls down the street, making people smile
Folks take selfies, it’s the star of the day
Who knew feline fashion could be so great?
Ugly but cool things, they really exist
Something ordinary can become a twist
A crooked smile can charm the crowd
Oddities, they make us proud
[ solo ]
Ugly but cool things, they really exist
Something ordinary can become a twist
Ugly is a matter of point of view
With a bit of whimsy, it can be cool too
[outro]
